layouts.name: Fontana Raceway Road Course
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The organizer identifies the historical 2.8-mile auto competition ROVAL. The pinned 2018 independent source retains the complete oval return, Northern rectangular infield hairpin, Eastern inner hairpin, Western infield S and short Southern diagonal chicane. The extra rectangular zigzag through the Northern paddock is excluded. Public-domain 2022 aerial imagery confirms these paved connections independently. The 4544.8 m trace remains unscaled against the 4509 m catalogue distance, with historical temporary barrier alignment and fine corner detail kept draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4544.8 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
